annotations.title: Wait for a build to finish processing

description: Poll until an uploaded build finishes processing (VALID), so the ship flow is one call. Pass build_number (the CFBundleVersion upload_binary names) right after an upload: Apple lists a new upload only after a few minutes, so the newest listed build can be an older one. Blocks for up to 30 minutes by default; if you should not hold the session that long, call list_builds yourself instead. Pro feature.

build_number.description: The build's CFBundleVersion, e.g. "2". Waits for that build to be listed and processed. Omit to take the newest listed build.

name: wait_for_build
